exposure: Pathologically confirmed retained products of conception (RPOC)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 96 women with a suspicion of retained products of conception following vaginal delivery.
finding: Pathologically confirmed retained products of conception (RPOC) after vaginal delivery are significantly associated with placental abruption and Oxytocin augmentation of labor, leading to higher rates of prolonged hospitalization, postpartum hemorrhage, hemoglobin drop, and blood transfusion.
